candidates.title: Will Casper Ruud win at least 3.5 more games than Nuno Borges?
candidates.rules_primary: If the game differential in favor of Casper Ruud across the full match is above 3.5 games in the Casper Ruud vs Nuno Borges professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP Paris Quarter Finals, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to the Casper Ruud vs Nuno Borges professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP Paris Quarter Finals. If the match does not occur (signaled by a ball being played) due to a player injury, walkover, forfeiture, or any other cancellation (all before the match starts), the market will resolve to a fair price in accordance with the rules. candidates.title: Omarion Hampton Receptions Ladder
candidates.rules_primary: If Each Yes contract pays $0.05 per reception recorded by Omarion Hampton during the Houston vs Los Angeles C Pro Football game originally scheduled for Nov 8, 2026. Each No contract pays $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Yes pays out at most $1.00. Then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
This is a scalar market. The Yes payout per contract is $0.05 per reception constrained between $0.00–$1.00 with a cap at 20 receptions. The No payout is $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Payouts are proportional to the size of the holder's position. For example, 8 receptions pays Yes $0.40 and No $0.60; 11 receptions pays Yes $0.55 and No $0.45; zero receptions pay Yes $0.00 and No $1.00.
